title: Different sides and a changing feeling
meaning: You can combine a wish with an actual condition and seek compatible communication while feelings about the answer found are still changing.
text: On your Vishuddha, Temperance in the physical position appears in joining a wish and an actual condition within an answer. Temperance in energy has another role: supporting the wish to combine different ways of communicating rather than destroy one for the other. The Wheel of Fortune in emotions brings a changing response. You can find an understandable combination and experience it differently at different moments. Constructing remarks need not immediately produce constant satisfaction.

For example, you discuss brief daytime messages together with a calmer evening conversation. An answer voices both wanting to share during the day and not expecting a full reply every time. **A suitable combination allows a changing feeling**. You seek a form retaining both wishes and hear the answer. Relief appears first; later, earlier detail may be missed. This does not yet prove the agreement wrong or make every regret automatically cancel its present meaning.

Imbalance appears if the successful combination is defended against every altered response. Seeking compatibility then becomes a rule that cannot be clarified. Constructive Temperance helps preserve different needs within an actual exchange. You can confirm what was accepted and separately name a new wish; compatibility requires no unchanging mood, while a changed feeling cannot assign another answer for you both without openly discussing present conditions and possibilities together.
